title: Aloo Posto
description: Bengali potatoes cooked in a creamy poppy seed paste with mustard oil and green chilli.
steps: Soak the poppy seeds in warm water for 20 minutes, then grind them with 2 green chillies and a splash of water to a smooth paste.
Heat the mustard oil until it smokes lightly and then reduce the heat.
Add the nigella seeds and dried red chilli, then add the potato cubes with turmeric and half the salt and fry for 5 minutes.
Add the poppy seed paste, sugar and the remaining salt, and mix so the potatoes are well coated.
Add the water, cover and cook on low heat for 10-12 minutes until the potatoes are tender and the paste has thickened.
Slit the remaining green chilli, add it with a squeeze of lemon juice and a drizzle of raw mustard oil if you like, then serve with rice.
